title: DVendo DITO Load independent transfer committed and archived; remote access remains blocked
summary: Prepared the owner-selected supplier/manager application in an isolated clean repository with initial commit de627ff4c3cb923aeb06cf356f9b7d84e6587fc1 and validation-note commit 08216492d41807a2866dc00ccb49a7cce092e8d0. The local origin targets ByteSpectreX/dvendo-dito-load. The project contains updated repository/package identity, owner authorization boundaries, preserved historical endpoint/provenance records, later sanitized Long Expiry research and a continuation guide. Build and all 21 offline tests passed in the copy and again from a fresh Git archive extraction. Documentation verification, 33 endpoint records and ten immutable historical imports passed; the committed preview rebuilt byte-identically. Editable text uses LF in Git while research bytes stay intact. Saved a verified complete Git bundle and source ZIP under exports for durable transfer. GitHub connector lookup returned 404 and elevated Git remote inspection returned HTTP 403 with write access not granted. The available GitHub app installation lists DVtech101625, not destination owner ByteSpectreX. Asked the owner to enable destination access; no remote push was attempted after the known rejection. The old origin, original applications and frozen handover were retained. No deployment, live provider query, OTP or purchase occurred.

evidence.description: Standalone application source archive prepared for the new repository.
Owner-selected destination; access not available through the current GitHub connection.

nextSteps: After the owner enables destination access, inspect the remote refs and push the prepared independent main branch without force.
If the temporary checkout is unavailable, clone the saved Git bundle and set its origin to the selected destination.
Continue the new app with authenticated membership and server-enforced supplier/manager scope.
